cohort: 701 pregnant women who delivered at the San Juan de Dios Hospital in Santiago between April 15, 2020 and June 15, 2020
finding: The prevalence of COVID-19 among pregnant women at delivery was 9.7%, with 67.7% of cases being asymptomatic, and while COVID-19 increased the rate of premature births, it was not associated with an increased C-section rate.
mod_finding: COVID-19 increased the rate of premature births, but this rate is not same with C-sections.
